title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
overview: The Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) course is designed to provide developers with the skills needed to design, build, test, and maintain cloud applications and services on Microsoft Azure. This course covers a range of topics including Azure services, development tools, and best practices to prepare participants for the AZ-204 certification exam.
audience: Software developers and engineers working with Azure.
Developers seeking to validate their skills in developing and maintaining Azure applications.
IT professionals looking to specialize in Azure development.
Individuals preparing for the Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) certification exam.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: In-depth explanations of Azure services and development tools.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for building and deploying applications on Azure.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to apply Azure development practices.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore Azure development challenges and solutions.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to measure understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a comprehensive understanding of developing applications on Microsoft Azure.
To prepare participants for the Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) exam.
To equip learners with practical skills for designing, building, and managing Azure applications.
To familiarize participants with Azure development tools, best practices, and security considerations.
